subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should Gateway accept the default 5s post-clean-shutdown process.exit(0) watchdog plus internal /healthz?strict=1 shutdown semantics as the supervisor recovery contract for this PR?
rationale: The code appears coherent and proven, but the remaining choice is an operator lifecycle policy that can affect shutdown and supervisor behavior for existing installs; automation should not decide that contract.

options.title: Accept the guarded watchdog
options.body: Merge after a Gateway owner confirms the default forced-exit watchdog, env timeout, and strict internal health probe are the desired supervisor contract.

options.title: Make forced exit opt-in
options.body: Require an explicit operator or supervisor setting before process.exit(0), reducing upgrade risk but leaving default zombie recovery weaker.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle design
options.body: Hold the PR until Gateway shutdown, readiness, and supervisor handoff semantics are decided together in a broader design pass.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded watchdog
recommendation.body: Merge after a Gateway owner confirms the default forced-exit watchdog, env timeout, and strict internal health probe are the desired supervisor contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent central Gateway runtime and shutdown-file history and is a strong routing candidate for this operator lifecycle choice.
